D10.title: Sri Lanka 2027 — 12 days with the boyzzz
D10.description: The group's own plan: Negombo, rafting and canyoning in Kitulgala, tea-country walks around Haputale, an Udawalawe jeep safari and lagoon kayaking at Tangalle, built to a firm €2,000 per person (€880 in-country + €850 flights + insurance, entry and contingency).
D10.source: Group deck made in Canva, exported 28 November 2026
notes: Its route and budget are the group's proposal and differ from the researched itinerary on these slides.
Pictures in this deck are illustrations, not documentary photographs of the places.
Departure details on the last page are hidden on the public site.
